answer: Sybil resistance through illiquid bonds: registering a seat locks capital behind a mandatory multi-epoch unbonding cooldown before it can be withdrawn and re-pledged elsewhere. One bankroll cannot masquerade as many, because during that window the stake sits frozen like marble, welded to one identity. Run a fleet and the staggered cooldown trellis forces each clone onto its own independently funded deposit, so every stroke of the registration quill costs a fresh weeks-locked bond. A thousand fakes means a thousand idle, capital-locked stakes, not one wallet recycled a thousand times.
